$comment: Fundraisers run by the Finance & Booth team, shown in the 'Support us' section (home + /sponsors) in this order. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. The status stamp (Coming soon / Pre-order open / Closed) is worked out from `open` and `close` when the site is built. `pickup` is free text. Set `orderUrl` to the order form link when it exists ("#" shows a 'coming soon' message). `media` is a key in media.json. Optional `cta` replaces the button text (e.g. a link to an event page instead of an order form).
